scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: mkdir -p client/public/images && cp -r server/public/images/* client/public/images/ && npm install --prefix client && npx prisma generate --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --prefix client
